notes: The English *of* in *taketh not account of evil* was given to `κακόν` as a case preposition, but `τὸ κακόν` is accusative and has no case for an English preposition to realize. The *of* is licensed by the supplied support noun *account*, which stands inside the `λογίζεται` unit, so rule 27 keeps it there; rule 106's accusative arm settles the same question from the other side. The verse otherwise already keeps a support frame whole inside its verb (`ἀσχημονεῖ` → *doth behave itself unseemly*), so this also removes an inconsistency within the verse. Heads and every status are unchanged.
